text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan receives European coordinator for peace in the Middle East Miguel Moratinos.
- Government officials and Moroccan businessmen confederation members meet over partnership issues.

- Draft law on regionalisation and giving large economic and financial powers to local council was delivered to the parliament secretariat. Story says the draft law is expected to be approved by the 333-seat parliament in February.
- Morocco phosphates giant Office Cherifien des Phosphates signs convention with the southern Khouribga commune.
- United Nations to examine Morocco's proposals on women's rights.
- Trial of 27 Moslem fundamentalist students to continue next week in Casablanca.
- Moroccan tourism receipts at $1.2 billion in 1996
- A maritime link to be set up soon between the northern city of Tangier and Faro in Portugal.
